title: Duck And Cover (1951) Bert The Turtle
summary: The 1951 US civil defense film 'Duck and Cover', starring Bert the Turtle, which taught schoolchildren to drop and shield themselves during a nuclear attack. It was shown to millions of children and is preserved in the National Film Registry.
why: HN uses it as an example of Cold War fear and persuasion, with some defending the advice as sensible against blast debris and others mocking it.

quote.text: Just getting under a desk or table away from any windows improves your chances of survival.
